name: hbis-outreach
description: Draft HBIS brief requests and follow-up chases to Hydra clients in Slack (email when they are not in Slack yet): resolves each client's channel and edition, checks the Hydra Production Tracker, renders the approved copy, and logs every send back to Asana. Never sends on its own — the operator reads and sends every message. Needs the Slack, Asana and Gmail connectors.
